data.title: Speeding fine of €98.50 (Bußgeldbescheid)
data.summary: The Landkreis Beispielheide fines office issued a fine notice for driving 23 km/h over the limit on 21 September 2025. The total is €98.50 including a €70.00 fine, and 1 point in the driving-fitness register (Fahreignungsregister). It was formally delivered on 17 October 2025.
data.explanation: You are accused of speeding (93 km/h in a 70 km/h zone). You can accept the fine or file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the Landkreis Beispielheide. The app shows the objection deadline, which counts from the delivery date of 17 October 2025. If you don't object, the notice becomes final and the total of €98.50 is due two weeks later. If you object, a court is not bound by the fine amount. If unsure, consider legal advice.
